name: minio
description: MinIO is a High Performance Object Storage released under GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. It is API compatible with Amazon S3 cloud storage service. Use MinIO to build high performance infrastructure for machine learning, analytics and application data workloads.

variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
variables.description: Specify the root username for MinIO

variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Specify the root password for MinIO

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: UMASK for newly created files. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
